name: hud_ui_mgr_on_viewport_changed
description: HudUiMgr::OnViewportChanged updates HUD/view rectangles, derived dimensions, reticle map constants, sensor viewport state, objective state, and top/chat text stack placement for the active viewport.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the HUD manager/source-cluster pass so text-stack and objective update member-call shape can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x40ff80 validates the HUD/view rectangle copies, width/height derivation, reticle constants, sensor viewport call, objective update call, layout activation dispatch, and top/chat stack color/position updates.

The native viewport activation smoke verifies the rectangle globals, derived dimensions, reticle map constants, sensor viewport rectangle, layout activation dispatch, objective widget state, shield reset, sensor state, and top/chat stack fields.
